objects.name: file:ori.config.yaml
content:
# ori.config.yaml - vault configuration for Ori Mnemos

vault:
  version: "0.1"

templates:
  default: templates/note.md
  by_type:
    map: templates/map.md
    moc: templates/map.md

vitality:
  model: "actr"
  actr_decay: 0.5
  decay:
    idea: 90
    decision: 30
    learning: 30

: 30
    blocker: 14
    opportunity: 30
  base: 1.0
  metabolic_rates:
    self: 0.1
    notes: 1.0
    ops: 3.0
  structural_boost_per_link: 0.1
  structural_boost_cap: 10
  revival_decay_rate: 0.2
  revival_window_days: 14
  access_saturation_k: 10

promote:
  auto: true               # ori add auto-promotes to notes/
  require_llm: false       # true = only auto-promote when LLM available
  min_confidence: 0.6      # below this, skip auto-promotion and warn
  project_keywords: {}     # project_name: [keyword, keyword, ...]
  project_map_routing: {}  # project_name: map_note_title
  default_area: "index"    # fallback area when no project match

llm:
  provider: null           # "anthropic" | "openai" (OpenAI-compatible)
  model: null              # e.g. "claude-sonnet-4-20250514", "gpt-4o", "qwen2.5"
  api_key_env: null        # env var name containing API key
  base_url: null           # API base URL (null = provider default)
  # Examples:
  #   Anthropic:  provider: "anthropic", model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514", api_key_env: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
  #   OpenAI:     provider: "openai", model: "gpt-4o", api_key_env: "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  #   Ollama:     provider: "openai", model: "llama3", base_url: "http://localhost:11434/v1"
  #   LM Studio:  provider: "openai", model: "local-model", base_url: "http://localhost:1234/v1"
  #   Kimi K2:    provider: "openai", model: "kimi-k2", api_key_env: "MOONSHOT_API_KEY", base_url: "https://api.moonshot.cn/v1"

graph:
  pagerank_alpha: 0.85
  bridge_vitality_floor: 0.5
  hub_degree_multiplier: 2.0

engine:
  embedding_model: "Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
  embedding_dims: 384
  piecewise_bins: 8
  community_dims: 16
  db_path: ".ori/embeddings.db"

retrieval:
  default_limit: 10
  candidate_multiplier: 5
  rrf_k: 60
  signal_weights:
    composite: 2.0
    keyword: 1.0
    graph: 1.5
  exploration_budget: 0.10

bm25:
  k1: 1.2
  b: 0.75
  title_boost: 3.0
  description_boost: 2.0

ips:
  enabled: true
  epsilon: 0.01
  log_path: "ops/access.jsonl"

schema index idx_episodes_agent episodes CREATE INDEX idx_episodes_agent
    ON episodes(agent_id, created_at DESC)
schema index idx_episodes_agent_channel episodes CREATE INDEX idx_episodes_agent_channel ON episodes(agent_id, channel, created_at DESC)
schema index idx_episodes_isolation episodes CREATE INDEX idx_episodes_isolation
    ON episodes(agent_id, project_id, created_at DESC)
schema index idx_episodes_lost_embedding episodes CREATE INDEX idx_episodes_lost_embedding
    ON episodes(id) WHERE embedding IS NULL
schema index idx_memories_agent memories CREATE INDEX idx_memories_agent
    ON memories(agent_id, created_at DESC)
schema index idx_memories_agent_channel memories CREATE INDEX idx_memories_agent_channel ON memories(agent_id, channel, created_at DESC)
schema index idx_memories_dedup_content memories CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_memories_dedup_content ON memories(agent_id, project_id, channel, content)
schema index idx_memories_dedup_msg_id memories CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_memories_dedup_msg_id ON memories(agent_id, project_id, msg_id) WHERE msg_id != ''
schema index idx_memories_isolation memories CREATE INDEX idx_memories_isolation
    ON memories(agent_id, project_id, created_at DESC)
schema index idx_memories_lost_embedding memories CREATE INDEX idx_memories_lost_embedding
    ON memories(id) WHERE embedding IS NULL
schema index idx_memories_msg_id memories CREATE INDEX idx_memories_msg_id
    ON memories(agent_id, msg_id)
schema index idx_memories_span memories CREATE INDEX idx_memories_span
    ON memories(agent_id, timestamp, project_id, channel)
schema table episodes episodes CREATE TABLE episodes (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    summary    TEXT NOT NULL,
    keywords   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    embedding  BLOB,
    start_time TEXT,
    end_time   TEXT,
    resolved   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    channel    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)
schema table episodes_fts episodes_fts CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE episodes_fts USING fts5(
    summary,
    keywords,
    content=episodes,
    content_rowid=id,
    tokenize='trigram'
)
schema table episodes_fts_config episodes_fts_config CREATE TABLE 'episodes_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
schema table episodes_fts_data episodes_fts_data CREATE TABLE 'episodes_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
schema table episodes_fts_docsize episodes_fts_docsize CREATE TABLE 'episodes_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
schema table episodes_fts_idx episodes_fts_idx CREATE TABLE 'episodes_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema table memories memories CREATE TABLE memories (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    msg_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    content    TEXT NOT NULL,
    source     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    timestamp  TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    embedding  BLOB,
    channel    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    recall_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_recalled_at TEXT,
    locked     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)
schema table memories_fts memories_fts CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memories_fts USING fts5(
    content,
    content=memories,
    content_rowid=id,
    tokenize='trigram'
)
schema table memories_fts_config memories_fts_config CREATE TABLE 'memories_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
schema table memories_fts_data memories_fts_data CREATE TABLE 'memories_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
schema table memories_fts_docsize memories_fts_docsize CREATE TABLE 'memories_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
schema table memories_fts_idx memories_fts_idx CREATE TABLE 'memories_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema table pending_memory_tasks pending_memory_tasks CREATE TABLE pending_memory_tasks (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    task_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    retries    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)
schema table profiles profiles CREATE TABLE profiles (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

_id    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    content    TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    UNIQUE(agent_id,

_id)
)
schema table schema_version schema_version CREATE TABLE schema_version (
    version    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)
schema trigger episodes_ad episodes CREATE TRIGGER episodes_ad AFTER DELETE ON episodes BEGIN
    INSERT INTO episodes_fts(episodes_fts, rowid, summary, keywords)
    VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.summary, old.keywords);
END
schema trigger episodes_ai episodes CREATE TRIGGER episodes_ai AFTER INSERT ON episodes BEGIN
    INSERT INTO episodes_fts(rowid, summary, keywords)
    VALUES (new.id, new.summary, new.keywords);
END
schema trigger episodes_au episodes CREATE TRIGGER episodes_au AFTER UPDATE OF summary, keywords ON episodes
WHEN old.summary <> new.summary OR old.keywords <> new.keywords BEGIN
    INSERT INTO episodes_fts(episodes_fts, rowid, summary, keywords)
    VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.summary, old.keywords);
    INSERT INTO episodes_fts(rowid, summary, keywords)
    VALUES (new.id, new.summary, new.keywords);
END
schema trigger memories_fts_ad memories CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts(memories_fts, rowid, content)
    VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.content);
END
schema trigger memories_fts_ai memories CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.id, new.content);
END
schema trigger memories_fts_au memories CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF content ON memories
WHEN old.content <> new.content BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts(memories_fts, rowid, content)
    VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.content);
    INSERT INTO memories_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.id, new.content);
END
